related.title: IEA 15 MW 參考風機
related.why: 可遷移能量守恆、熱路、載荷與驗證證據；熱源、工作流體及安全邊界不同。
related.whyEn: Energy conservation, heat paths, loads and validation evidence transfer, with different heat sources, fluids and safety boundaries.
related.transfer: 可遷移能量守恆、熱路、載荷與驗證證據；熱源、工作流體及安全邊界不同。
related.transferEn: Energy conservation, heat paths, loads and validation evidence transfer, with different heat sources, fluids and safety boundaries.
related.difference: 本課針對遠岸直驅陣列、颱風環境與供應鏈；IEA 15 MW 參考風機改以開放氣彈性模型與大型風輪設計為架構重點，不能直接沿用幾何、邊界或產品數值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on farshore direct-drive arrays, typhoons and supply chains; IEA 15 MW reference wind turbine centers on open aeroelastic models and large-rotor design, so geometry, boundaries and product values cannot transfer unchanged.
practice: 對照彰化風資源與typhoon與15MW風速功率包絡，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。
把本課假想算例移到IEA 15 MW 參考風機，列出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以臺灣O&M與窗口為起點，設計一項能區分「遠岸直驅陣列、颱風環境與供應鏈」與「開放氣彈性模型與大型風輪設計」的觀測，註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare changhua resources/typhoons with 15-mw wind/power envelope and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to IEA 15 MW reference wind turbine, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from taiwan o&m/windows and propose an observation distinguishing farshore direct-drive arrays, typhoons and supply chains from open aeroelastic models and large-rotor design, including uncertainty.

related.title: 海上福爾摩沙離岸風電場
related.transfer: 可遷移「掃掠面積與比功率」與「吸力桶的下沉力」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；海上福爾摩沙離岸風電場的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Swept area and specific power" and "Sinking force of a suction bucket" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Formosa Offshore Wind Farm must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦臺灣最大的離岸風場：60 Hz 長距離輸出海纜、吸力桶基礎與企業購電合約；海上福爾摩沙離岸風電場則以臺灣首批商轉離岸風場：颱風等級風機、導管架基礎與不設離岸變電站的 66 kV 送電為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on taiwan's largest offshore wind farm: long 60 Hz export cables, suction-bucket foundations and a corporate power purchase agreement; Formosa Offshore Wind Farm centres on taiwan's first commercial offshore wind farms: typhoon-class turbines, jacket foundations and 66 kV export with no offshore substation, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「年發電量與容量因數」與「年發電量與容量因數」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「尾流虧損與機組間距」的模型移到海上福爾摩沙離岸風電場，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「海上安裝的天氣窗」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Annual energy and capacity factor".
Move the model of "Wake deficit and turbine spacing" to Formosa Offshore Wind Farm, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Weather windows for offshore installation", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「掃掠面積與比功率」與「吸力桶的下沉力」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；海上福爾摩沙離岸風電場的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Swept area and specific power" and "Sinking force of a suction bucket" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Formosa Offshore Wind Farm must be respecified.

related.title: SG 14-222 DD 直驅離岸風機
related.titleEn: Siemens Gamesa SG 14-222 DD Offshore Wind Turbine
related.transfer: 可遷移「掃掠面積與比功率」與「吸力桶的下沉力」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；SG 14-222 DD 直驅離岸風機的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Swept area and specific power" and "Sinking force of a suction bucket" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Siemens Gamesa SG 14-222 DD Offshore Wind Turbine must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦臺灣最大的離岸風場：60 Hz 長距離輸出海纜、吸力桶基礎與企業購電合約；SG 14-222 DD 直驅離岸風機則以直驅 14 MW 風機：機艙重量、在臺灣海峽的部署與葉片前緣的雨蝕為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on taiwan's largest offshore wind farm: long 60 Hz export cables, suction-bucket foundations and a corporate power purchase agreement; Siemens Gamesa SG 14-222 DD Offshore Wind Turbine centres on A direct-drive 14 MW turbine: nacelle weight, deployment in the Taiwan Strait and rain erosion of blade leading edges, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「年發電量與容量因數」與「掃掠面積與比功率」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「尾流虧損與機組間距」的模型移到SG 14-222 DD 直驅離岸風機，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「結構自然頻率與 1P、3P」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Swept area and specific power".
Move the model of "Wake deficit and turbine spacing" to Siemens Gamesa SG 14-222 DD Offshore Wind Turbine, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Structural natural frequency and 1P, 3P", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「掃掠面積與比功率」與「吸力桶的下沉力」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；SG 14-222 DD 直驅離岸風機的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Swept area and specific power" and "Sinking force of a suction bucket" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Siemens Gamesa SG 14-222 DD Offshore Wind Turbine must be respecified.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 大彰化離岸風電場
history.text: 大彰化離岸風電場的公開資料展示遠岸直驅陣列、颱風環境與供應鏈的工程脈絡；本課以不同功能層與可驗證輸出重建教學案例，不宣稱取得任何專有製造流程。
history.textEn: Public sources for Greater Changhua Offshore Wind Farms illustrate farshore direct-drive arrays, typhoons and supply chains. The course reconstructs functional layers and verifiable outputs educationally without proprietary manufacturing access.

history.title: 從工程故事到可檢查模型
history.titleEn: From engineering story to reviewable models
history.text: 本課將遠岸直驅陣列、颱風環境與供應鏈改寫為原創離線分析題；不複製來源的製造圖、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns farshore direct-drive arrays, typhoons and supply chains into original offline analysis exercises without copying manufacturing drawings, video transcripts or field procedures.
